ModMetaData.name: Auto Turrets
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Every turret, mortar and gun emplacement – vanilla and from any mod – works without a colonist.
- Turrets that need a colonist to man them shoot on their own (you can still aim them by hand). - Mortars fire automatically while loaded; haulers bring shells to them (Hauling work, respects the mortar's shell filter). They don't fire where shells could land on your people. - Turrets that rearm with steel (or another single metal) accept any metal: plasteel, gold, uranium, metals from mods (silver optional).
Only your own turrets change – enemy siege mortars still need their crew. Everything can be switched in the mod settings. Safe to add to an existing save. Czech and English.
